name: Scorbunny
notes: Painted design: white fur with faint soft strokes on head (3), body (12), arms (15), head and cheek tufts (7, 10, 14, 17), tail (19) and the lower ears; ears (2, 8, 11, 13) orange at the top with clearer strokes, a pale orange band and a yellow inner-ear mark (2, 13); feet (16, 18) white with orange toe caps split by dark toe lines; thin dark finger lines on the hands (15); orange nose (4), red band (5), mouth (6), island 9 a small white tuft with dark painted strokes at its base.

So: short soft fur along the painted strokes (Scorbunny's white is clean: the albedo strands are kept faint, 1%, and the baked cavity low, so it never reads grey or dirty), slightly longer at the ear tips and tufts; toe caps keep their dark toe lines crisp, finger lines crisp; yellow ear marks, nose, band and mouth untouched.

Body shader 3676778037 is the flocky fur shader with dummy_flocky_texture as its normal (the fur noise), so in game only _dif and _par change; the authored Body_nor is cache-only (would replace the flocky noise via a material change).
